topic: A Single GPU Chip Contains More Transistors Than Stars in the Milky Way
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know GPUs Have More Transistors Than Stars in Our Galaxy? ⭐

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 NVIDIA's B200 GPU contains 208 billion transistors on a single chip package. The Milky Way galaxy contains an estimated 100-400 billion stars.
